message:
In the twin under-deck Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, mass on spring with damper tuned to bridge mode) retrofit proposal, the voting and linkage method has premature readiness with an empty concept list. To check it I used whiteboard review of the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (E6). I found 0.74 metres per second squared controlled acceleration with no linked concepts, according to Setra, 2006. I propose Structural Dynamics Lead please relink Concepts 1 to 4 to the proposal. My position: not ready because vote came too early.

In the concealed twin TMD support concept, the host cross-girder capacity method has missing verification. To check it I used review of the clamp-beam stress check (E14) with the unit weight calculation (E10). I found 16.54 megapascals in new steelwork and 2452.5 newtons per unit with no host girder stress, according to European Committee for Standardization, 2005. I propose Retrofit Integration Architect please compute existing cross-girder bending and shear including dynamic force. My position: not ready because load path is incomplete.

Note on Structural Dynamics Lead: proposal linkage requested.
Note on Retrofit Integration Architect: host capacity check requested.
